q: Methodologies are:
choices: A sequence of step-by-step approaches that help develop the information system

q: Techniques are:
choices: Processes the analyst follows to ensure thorough, complete and comprehensive analysis and design

q: Tools are:
choices: Computer programs that aid in applying techniques

q: Which is NOT one of the four activities in all software processes?
Validation means:
choices: Checking that the system does what the customer wants
Defining what the system should do
Changing the system for new needs
explain: **Validation** = التأكد إنه بيعمل اللي العميل عايزه.

q: Evolution means:
choices: Changing the system in response to changing customer needs

q: In plan-driven processes:
choices: All activities are planned in advance and progress is measured against the plan

q: In agile processes:
choices: Planning is incremental and it is easier to change the process for changing requirements

q: Which statement is correct?
choices: Most practical processes include elements of both plan-driven and agile approaches
explain: أغلب العمليات فيها عناصر من الاتنين، ومفيش عملية صح أو غلط.

q: Which is an agile modeling practice?
explain: الـ agile modeling: small increments, parallel models, stakeholder participation.

q: The waterfall model has how many phases in the lecture?
explain: Requirements ← Design ← Implementation & unit testing ← Integration & system testing ← Operation & maintenance = **5**.

q: The first phase of the waterfall model is:
The main drawback of the waterfall model is:
choices: Difficulty accommodating change after the process is underway
It is only for small systems

q: The waterfall model is appropriate when:
choices: Requirements are well understood and changes will be limited
The customer does not know the requirements

q: The waterfall model is mostly used for:
choices: Large systems engineering projects developed at several sites

q: In incremental development:
choices: Specification, development and validation are interleaved

q: Which is a benefit of incremental development?
choices: Lower cost of accommodating changing requirements
explain: تكلفة التغيير أقل، feedback أسهل، تسليم أسرع.

q: Which is a problem of incremental development?
choices: The process is not visible and system structure tends to degrade

q: Which is an advantage of incremental delivery?
choices: The highest priority services tend to receive the most testing

q: How many sectors does the spiral model have in the lecture?
explain: Objective setting · Risk assessment & reduction · Development & validation · Planning.

q: Which sector assesses risks and puts activities in place to reduce key risks?
A disadvantage of the spiral model is:
choices: It should not be used if risk analysis will greatly affect project profits
explain: لو تحليل المخاطر هيأثر كتير في الأرباح ماينفعش.

q: A prototype is:
choices: An initial version of a system used to demonstrate concepts and try out design options

q: Prototyping is applied when:
choices: Customers do not know the exact project requirements
explain: لما العميل مش عارف المتطلبات بالظبط.

q: Which is a benefit of prototyping?
explain: تحسين usability وجودة التصميم وmaintainability وتقليل الجهد.

q: A throw-away prototype is:
choices: Discarded after being used to elicit requirements

q: Reuse-oriented software engineering means:
choices: The system is built from scratch
The system is assembled from existing components

q: The waterfall model, incremental development and reuse-oriented engineering are examples of:
In the incremental model, which is easier to get compared with the waterfall model?
choices: Customer feedback on the work done

q: Which is a criterion for selecting a methodology?
explain: المعايير: clear requirements, familiar technology, complexity, time schedule, schedule visibility.
